content.json: **NOTE**: This workbook depends on a parser based on Kusto Function to work as expected [**BoxEvents**](https://aka.ms/sentinel-BoxDataConnector-parser) which is deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel Solution.

content.query:
BoxEvents
| make-series TotalEvents = count() default = 0 on EventEndTime from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain};
content.title: Events over time

content.query:
BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(EventType)
| summarize TotalEvents = count() by EventType
content.title: Event Types

content.query:
let user1 = BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(SourceName)
| summarize Users = dcount(SourceName) by SourceName
| project Users, User = SourceName;
let user2 = BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(SrcUserName)
| summarize Users = count(SrcUserName) by SrcUserName
| project Users, User = SrcUserName;
let user3 = BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(AccessibleByName)
| summarize Users = dcount(AccessibleByName) by AccessibleByName
| project Users, User = AccessibleByName;
let users = union user1, user2, user3;
users
| summarize Users = dcount(User)
content.title: Unique Users
Unique files

content.query:
let files_1 = BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime > ago(90d)
| where isnotempty(SourceFileName)
| summarize TotalItems = dcount(SourceFileName) by SourceFileName
| project TotalItems, FileName = SourceFileName;
let files_2 = BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime > ago(90d)
| where isnotempty(SourceItemName)
| summarize TotalItems = dcount(SourceItemName) by SourceItemName
| project TotalItems, FileName = SourceItemName;
let known_files = (union files_1, files_2)
| summarize makeset(FileName);
BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime between (ago(24h) .. now())
| where isnotempty(SourceFileName) 
| project FileName = SourceFileName
| union (BoxEvents
    | where EventEndTime between (ago(24h) .. now())
    | where isnotempty(SourceItemName)
    | project FileName = SourceItemName)
| where FileName !in (known_files)
| summarize dcount(FileName)
content.title: New files (last 24h)

content.query:
BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime > ago(90d)
| where EventType == 'ADMIN_LOGIN'
| summarize Username = dcount(SourceName) by SourceName
| project SourceName
content.title: Admin users

content.query:
let admins = BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime > ago(90d)
| where EventType == 'ADMIN_LOGIN'
| summarize makeset(SourceName);
let adm_type1 = BoxEvents
| where SourceName in (admins)
| summarize TotalActions = count() by SourceName;
let adm_type2 = BoxEvents
| where SrcUserName in (admins)
| summarize TotalActions = count() by SrcUserName
| project TotalActions, SourceName = SrcUserName; 
let adm_activity = (union adm_type1, adm_type2);
adm_activity
| summarize TotalActions = sum(TotalActions) by SourceName
| join kind = inner (BoxEvents
 | where SourceName in (admins) or SrcUserName in (admins)
 | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on EventEndTime from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by SourceName)
 on SourceName
| project SourceName, TotalActions, Trend
| order by TotalActions
content.title: Admin users activity

content.query:
let admins = BoxEvents
| where EventEndTime > ago(90d)
| where EventType == 'ADMIN_LOGIN'
| summarize makeset(SourceName);
let adm_type1 = BoxEvents
| where SourceName in (admins)
| summarize by EventType, SourceName
| project Action = EventType, SourceName;
let adm_type2 = BoxEvents
| where SrcUserName in (admins)
| summarize max(EventEndTime) by EventType, SrcUserName
| project Action = EventType, SourceName = SrcUserName; 
let adm_activity = (union adm_type1, adm_type2);
adm_activity
content.title: Latest admin activity

content.query:
BoxEvents
| where EventType == 'LOGIN'
| summarize LastLoginTime = max(EventEndTime) by SourceName
| where LastLoginTime > ago(90d)
content.title: Inactive users

content.query:
let user_act1 = BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(SourceName)
| summarize TotalActions = count() by SourceName;
let user_act2 = BoxEvents
| where isnotempty(SrcUserName)
| summarize TotalActions = count() by SrcUserName
| project TotalActions, SourceName = SrcUserName; 
let user_activity = (union user_act1, user_act2);
user_activity
| join kind = inner (BoxEvents
 | where isnotempty(SourceName) or isnotempty(SrcUserName)
 | make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on EventEndTime from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by SourceName)
 on SourceName
| project SourceName, TotalActions, Trend
| order by TotalActions
content.title: Users activity over time

content.query:
BoxEvents
| summarize Downloads = countif(EventType == "DOWNLOAD"), Uploads = countif(EventType == "UPLOAD") by bin_at(EventEndTime, 1h, now())
content.title: Downloads/Uploads comparison

content.query:
BoxEvents
| where EventType == 'DOWNLOAD'
| where isnotempty(SourceItemName)
| project FileName = SourceItemName, SrcUserName, EventEndTime
| top 100 by EventEndTime desc
content.title: Latest downloaded items

content.query:
BoxEvents
| where EventType == 'UPLOAD'
| where isnotempty(SourceItemName)
| project FileName = SourceItemName, SrcUserName, EventEndTime
| top 100 by EventEndTime desc
content.title: Latest uploaded items
